title: DNA aptamers that inhibit binding to human interleukin-17A and interleukin-20

DNA aptamers can inhibit binding to cytokines interleukin-17 (IL-17) and interleukin-20 (IL-20), which play important roles in inflammatory processes and autoimmune diseases.
